about.title: About Chery Finn CPAs
text: Chery Finn CPAs is a Houston-area accounting firm serving individuals, business owners, and clients with complex tax situations. Our work includes tax preparation and planning, business accounting, payroll, IRS representation, and foreign account compliance.

Today, the firm is led by Vlad Chery, CPA, Managing Shareholder, with Jay Finn, CPA, founder and former IRS Revenue Agent, continuing as part of the Chery Finn CPAs team. That combination keeps the firm grounded in practical tax, accounting, and IRS-resolution experience without presenting any one person as the entire firm.

Chery Finn CPAs brings together CPAs, an Enrolled Agent, and experienced tax and accounting professionals across business tax, IRS representation, accounting, payroll, foreign tax compliance, and individual tax matters.
